node: NODETOPO-O0 authentic raw-image proposal prerequisite and false-node stress diagnostic
purpose: Replace the previously absent candidate prerequisite with a label-independent raw-image proposal bank and measure, without fitting or threshold selection, the official-score sensitivity to a deterministic small number of topology-complete false-node actions.

raw_proposal_contract.route_source: reuse the banked passing two-dataset raw-Zarr smoke; no outcome-driven route selection
raw_proposal_contract.frames: every frame in each of the fixed 36 fit105 44b6 raw Zarr arrays
raw_proposal_contract.storage: one deterministic compressed NPZ per video plus a canonical JSON hash manifest
raw_proposal_contract.failure: any input/hash/identity/coverage/determinism mismatch fails closed before stress scoring

post_freeze_label_join.purpose: report-only candidate support and deterministic background designation after the immutable raw bank exists
post_freeze_label_join.positive_definition: one-to-one minimum-distance assignment to same-time fit GT within 7 um
post_freeze_label_join.background_definition: every raw proposal not selected by that positive assignment
post_freeze_label_join.hard_false_definition: background proposal whose nearest same-time GT distance is strictly greater than 14 um, or a frame with no fit GT
post_freeze_label_join.selection_leakage_rule: GT never changes raw candidate coordinates, route, ordering, or proposal inclusion

topology_join.baseline: hash-pinned fitcache_117 fragment for the same identity
topology_join.construction: for a hard-false candidate at 1<=t<T-1, connect nearest baseline node at t-1 to the new node and the new node to nearest baseline node at t+1, each within 8 um; replace the predecessor outgoing and successor incoming boundaries with their exact frozen-N1 incident conflicts
topology_join.batch_conflict_policy: greedily retain in that order only actions with unique replacement source, replacement target, added node, added edge, and removed-edge ownership; this is fixed before scores
topology_join.validity: every retained action must compile singly and every requested per-video batch must compile under frozen N1

false_node_stress.construction: take the first k globally ordered, mutually batch-compatible hard-false topology actions without changing positives or choosing k from outcomes
false_node_stress.comparison: unchanged official Python scorer wrappers and official_summary on the same 36 44b6 videos; baseline is the exact frozen fragment set
false_node_stress.report: for every k report selected actions, per-video N1 graph hashes, aggregate adjusted/raw/node values and deltas, compile counts, and resource use
false_node_stress.selection: no point on the curve selects a threshold, tier, model, or family opening

decision_lines.universe_go: all 36 fixed 44b6 identities covered over all raw frames, exact input and output hashes, zero label fields in raw banks, deterministic replay equality, and finite exact background count
decision_lines.universe_park: any missing/mismatched input, incomplete raw-frame coverage, label contamination, nondeterminism, undefined background, or provenance ambiguity
decision_lines.topology_go: at least 50 mutually batch-compatible hard-false actions and 100% frozen-N1 single/batch validity
decision_lines.topology_park: fewer than 50 compatible actions or any N1 compile failure
decision_lines.stress_interpretation: diagnostic curve only; no authoritative comparison rule or tier rule changes
decision_lines.second_family: closed regardless of diagnostic result; a binding root 44b6 graph gate is required to open 6bba
